tool.name: Larch Extract Group
tool.description: extract Athena groups to Galaxy distinct datasets

param.name: energy_column
param.label: Energy column
param.help: If set, this column will be used as 'energy'. Otherwise, will identify the first column ending with 'energy' or labelled 'col1' 'Ef'.

param.name: energy_column_text
param.label: Energy column
param.help: The column to be used as 'energy'.

param.name: mu_column
param.label: μ column
param.help: If set, this column will be used as 'mu'. Otherwise, will identify the first column labelled as either 'col2', 'xmu', 'lni0it', 'FFI0' or 'FF/I1'.

param.name: mu_column_text
param.label: μ column
param.help: The column to be used as 'mu'.

param.name: extract_group
param.label: Group extraction
param.help: Method of handling group extraction. Extracting all or multiple named groups will result in multiple outputs.

param.name: group_name
param.label: Group label
param.help: Which group to extract and process from the Athena project (will use first group in file if unset)

param.name: annotation
param.label: New annotation
param.help: If set, will annotate the output project with this string. This will be used to generate legends when plotting data.

param.name: regex_find
param.label: Regex find
param.help: If set, will use regex to find all instances of the this pattern and replace it.

param.name: regex_replace
param.label: Regex replace
param.help: If set, will use regex to replace all found instances with this. If unset, will effectively remove the find pattern.

tool.command: mkdir prj cdif #if $is_zipped.is_zipped=="true" && echo Unzipping '$is_zipped.dat_file.name' && unzip '$is_zipped.dat_file' -d dat_files && larch_extract_group dat_files #if $is_zipped.energy_column.energy_column=="other" --energy-column='$is_zipped.energy_column.energy_column_text' #else --energy-column='$is_zipped.energy_column.energy_column' #end if #if $is_zipped.mu_column.mu_column=="other" --mu-column='$is_zipped.mu_column.mu_column_text' #else --mu-column='$is_zipped.mu_column.mu_column' #end if #if $is_zipped.extract_group.extract_group=="all" --extract-all --regex-find='$is_zipped.extract_group.regex_find' --regex-replace='$is_zipped.extract_group.regex_replace' \ #else #for $repeat in $is_zipped.extract_group.multiple --extract-label='$repeat.group_name' --annotation='$repeat.annotation' #end for #end if #else && larch_extract_group '$is_zipped.format.dat_file' #if $is_zipped.format.format=="other" #if $is_zipped.format.energy_column.energy_column=="other" --energy-column='$is_zipped.format.energy_column.energy_column_text' #else --energy-column='$is_zipped.format.energy_column.energy_column' #end if #if $is_zipped.format.mu_column.mu_column=="other" --mu-column='$is_zipped.format.mu_column.mu_column_text' #else --mu-column='$is_zipped.format.mu_column.mu_column' #end if #else #if $is_zipped.format.extract_group.extract_group=="all" --extract-all --regex-find='$is_zipped.format.extract_group.regex_find' --regex-replace='$is_zipped.format.extract_group.regex_replace' #else #for $repeat in $is_zipped.format.extract_group.multiple --extract-label='$repeat.group_name' --annotation='$repeat.annotation' #end for #end if #end if #end if --output-directory=prj $cdif

param.name: is_zipped
param.label: Inputs Zipped
param.help: Whether input files are zipped together into one directory, or not.

param.name: format
param.label: Input format
param.help: Whether data is in HDF5 (NeXus) or ASCII (XDI or other plaintext) format, or has already saved as an Athena project

param.name: dat_file
param.label: XAFS data file
param.help: X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) data, either in HDF5 (NeXus) or ASCII (XDI or other plaintext) format.

param.name: dat_file
param.label: Athena project
param.help: X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) data, in Athena project format

param.name: dat_file
param.label: Zipped XAFS data files
param.help: Zipped X-ray Absorption Fine Structure (XAFS) data, either in NeXus (h5) or tabular format.

param.name: cdif
param.label: Generate CDIF
param.help: Generate XAS CDIF profiles for all output Athena projects containing metadata for the spectra.

tool.help:
Using Larch, create an Athena project file from the input X-ray Absorption Fine Structure (XAFS) data file.
Accepts both tabular and NeXus/HDF5 formatted data or a zip file containing these formats. If column names are not present in tabular data, then the first column is treated as `energy` and the second as `mu`. Note that in order to ensure a consistent output, once unzipped all files will sorted first by their parent directories (alphabetically). Within a given directory, if all filenames contain digits then the last block of digits will be used to sort the files numerically. In the output, all files (regardless of initial filepath) are output in a flat hierarchy, with the number in which it was processed as the file name (zero-padded). Care should therefore be taken to ensure input data is consistent with this treatment.
